name: Clawd Banner Body Color (Neon Violet)
description: Recolors the Clawd startup-banner body in the default (dark) theme from the stock orange rgb(215,119,87) to Neon Violet rgb(188,19,254). Mirrors the color edit of nguyenngocviet191/claude-code-mod-banner (the only same-length, identifier-independent part of that mod). Purely visual; no behavior change.

provenance.author: nguyenngocviet191
provenance.derived_by: reverse-engineered from patch-icon.js color regex (clawd_body rgb) + bot-presets.json neon preset; mapped to utils/theme.ts:161 default dark theme; anchored same-length in 2.1.158 binary

operations.rationale: The bare string clawd_body:"rgb(215,119,87)" occurs 4 times (one per rgb-bodied theme); the mod's /g regex hits all 4 but a verified ccx edit needs a unique anchor. Extending left to the per-theme-unique diffRemovedWord:"rgb(209,69,75)" token isolates the first/default dark theme (theme.ts:161), which drives the startup banner. Only the trailing clawd_body color value (15 chars) is changed; the anchor is otherwise echoed verbatim, keeping total length identical.

archive_reason: banner color anchor absent on 2.1.158; needs re-derivation
